title: Redirect follower strips Authorization cross-host and refuses loops
source: Authored for the CodeReview benchmark corpus (generation-v3 clean-authored stratum), 2026-11-05
false_flag_note: A reviewer might flag that Authorization is preserved on a redirect whose host differs only by case, or that a 303 drops the original method semantics. Host comparison is case-insensitive per DNS rules, so that hop is genuinely same-host, and switching POST to GET on 303 is the standard-mandated behaviour; method is preserved for 301/302/307/308.
